recipes.doc: Baseline + keep contact peaks plus enough extra cells that no gap along a run exceeds n-1, so an n x n robot still cannot slip past.
Baseline + exact pass: free every remaining wall whose removal opens no new n x n robot placement. Thins lines to a picket at spacing n without guessing.
black_relative, then the exact pass. The spacing rule and the placement rule agree on straight runs, so this mostly shows what the exact pass finds that the gap heuristic misses at corners.
The only PROVABLY lossless recipe: nothing is removed but walls the robot could never cross, so the state space — and therefore the switch count — cannot move. Always reports PRESERVED.
